_doc: Measured text budgets per box variant (phase 5 width gate), read by tools/lint.py. px = sum of the half-width VWF advances (engine.half_widths) of the line; English is plain ASCII drawn with the half-width font (window font mode 3). status: measured (with the shot) or guess.

dialogue.what: script archive message body: the speaker box with a portrait (text from x=40); the engine pages every 2 lines, a blank line forces a new page, the page arrow sits at the right end of the 2nd line
dialogue.shot: map_290 with build.py --qa 34.10=...: 130 x I clipped at x=232 (pen 192); arrow at x=225-230 on line 2 (work/qa/torture3, work/qa/torture5)

name_tag.what: first line of a script archive message (speaker); the tag box grows with the byte count, about 6 px per byte from x=8
name_tag.shot: map_290, 'Baron Ashura (Male) Professor Kuruma' (36 bytes) fits, box ends at x=229 (work/qa/tag)

item_list.what: item menu list name field (8x8 font, 8-px VWF): from the name's x to the count graphic; both columns
item_list.shot: m1_item marker build: left name x=25, count x=96; right name x=136, count x=205 (work/qa/v8_m1_item); not yet mapped to script/rom ids in the lint

name_var.what: {p} / {s}: the player-entered hero / heroine name, inserted at run time; counted at this width in a line
name_var.shot: name entry takes 7 chars (work/qa/namelen3: the 8th A confirms); kana draw at 12 px in a line ('|{p}|' with the default メイン = 36 px, work/qa/pvar), so 7 x 12. The JP keeps the same room (<= 9 other chars beside {p})
